title: Titanium Slip-On Flange
function: Slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Slip-On Flange where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by slip-on flange for low-pressure chemical ducting and fat life requirements.

commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for slipon flange for performance

faq.q: How does Titanium Slip-On Flange perform in chloride-containing process streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti is the material of choice for wet chlorine, hypochlorite, and chlorinated organic media where stainless steels (316L, 904L) pit within weeks. The TiO₂ passive film maintains stability in chloride concentrations up to saturated levels at pH 2-12 for slipon flange for. No critical pitting temperature up to 260°C — significantly exceeding all stainless steel grades.

faq.a: Each Titanium Slip-On Flange shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for slipon flange for.
